Game Overview

In Rabbit Rush, the core idea is straightforward: in Rabbit Rush, sprint through vibrant meadows as a nimble rabbit, outpacing a persistent dog. Dodge spiky hedgehogs, strategize your path, and boost speed by munching on carrots. Test your reflexes and planning skills in this energetic chase where every carrot counts!
